title: FoRe: A Force-Guided Framework for Autonomous Grasp Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance in grasp-based manipulation, yet reliable recovery from local grasping failures remains challenging. Specifically, in pick-and-place tasks, policies may continue transport after a failed grasp instead of retrying, potentially reflecting overreliance on proprioceptive cues for stage progression and limited retry supervision. Existing recovery approaches typically rely on deployment-time guidance or demonstration augmentation. We introduce Force-guided Recovery (FoRe), a framework for autonomous recovery from local grasping failures. Using force feedback, FoRe partitions demonstrations into approach-grasp and transport-placement stages to train separate policies. To supplement limited retry supervision, FoRe then initializes a dedicated retry policy from the approach-grasp policy and refines it through local reinforcement learning (RL) from post-failure states. translated_title: FoRe：一种用于视觉-语言-动作模型中自主抓取恢复的力引导框架
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型在基于抓取的操作任务中展现出了强大的性能，然而从局部抓取失败中进行可靠恢复仍然具有挑战性。具体而言，在拾取与放置任务中，策略可能在抓取失败后仍继续搬运物体而不进行重试，这可能反映出其对本体感觉线索进行阶段推进的过度依赖，以及重试监督数据的匮乏。现有的恢复方法通常依赖于部署时的引导或演示数据增强。我们提出了力引导恢复框架，这是一个用于从局部抓取失败中实现自主恢复的框架。通过利用力反馈，FoRe 将演示数据划分为接近-抓取和搬运-放置两个阶段，分别训练独立的策略。为补充有限的重试监督数据，FoRe 随后从接近-抓取策略初始化一个专用的重试策略，并通过从失败后状态出发的局部强化学习对其进行优化。
tldr: 该论文提出FoRe框架，利用力反馈将演示数据划分为接近-抓取与搬运-放置阶段分别训练策略，并通过局部强化学习从失败后状态优化专用重试策略，实现视觉-语言-动作模型从抓取失败中的自主恢复。
en_tdlr: FoRe is a force-guided framework that enables autonomous grasp recovery in VLA models by using force feedback to partition demonstrations into approach-grasp and transport-placement stages, and refining a dedicated retry policy through local reinforcement learning from post-failure states.
